children: Overview
Alaska community bank's Q3 net income and EPS declined yr/yr due to higher credit losses
Q3 net interest income and margin rose, supported by deposit growth and higher loan balances
Company continues progress on previously announced PBCO Financial acquisition, expected to close Q1 2027
Outlook
Northrim expects to complete PBCO Financial acquisition in Q1 2027, pending approvals
Company anticipates more than $4 bln in assets after PBCO acquisition
Northrim says collection of a Specialty Finance loan impairment may take several quarters to resolve
Result Drivers
CREDIT LOSS PROVISION - Co said higher provision for credit losses tied to a single relationship in Specialty Finance segment reduced Q3 earnings
NET INTEREST INCOME - Record net interest income and net interest margin above 5% drove a 21% increase in pre-provision net revenue, per CEO Mike Huston
MORTGAGE SEGMENT - Co said Home Mortgage Lending segment had a strong quarter, supported by increased mortgage servicing revenue and fair value gains
